headline: The CIA once ran a San Francisco apartment where strangers were secretly dosed with LSD.
slides: A federal narcotics agent, George Hunter White, set up a CIA safehouse on Telegraph Hill, San Francisco.
It was a sub-project of the CIA's mind-control research program, code-named Operation Midnight Climax.
Men were lured to the apartment and given LSD without knowing, while agents watched through a two-way mirror.
To see whether the drug made people talk, and whether it could be used in interrogations.
Similar safehouses ran in Marin County and New York City.
The San Francisco houses closed in 1965 and New York's in 1966. Most MKUltra files were destroyed in 1973.
